mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.reservation_no, r.room_id, rooms.room_number, rooms.room_name, rooms.cleaning_status AS room_cleaning_status, r.check_in_date, r.check_out_date, r.guest_name, r.guest_kana, r.guest_gender, r.guest_age, r.guest_phone, r.guest_email, r.guest_count, r.reservation_form, r.payment_status, r.reservation_status, r.total_amount, r.note, r.created_at, r.updated_at, COALESCE(string_agg(rg.guest_name || '（' || COALESCE(rg.guest_gender, '未入力') || '・' || COALESCE(CAST(rg.guest_age AS varchar), '未入力') || '歳・' || COALESCE(rg.guest_phone, '連絡先未入力') || '）', '、' ORDER BY rg.id), '') AS companion_summary FROM reservations r JOIN rooms ON rooms.id = r.room_id LEFT JOIN reservation_guests rg ON rg.reservation_id = r.id WHERE r.reservation_status = 'booked' GROUP BY r.id, rooms.room_number, rooms.room_name, rooms.cleaning_status ORDER BY r.check_in_date DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 100
